vendors.name: Poster
vendors.reason: Own Kazakhstan site with a food-truck page (compare-research-2). Its ordering website is the paid Poster Site add-on, not part of any plan. Prices show the same billed-yearly ambiguity as UA, so count it only if Dominic accepts that.

plans.note: Only billing label on the page: 'Оплата за год' (no monthly label, no yearly total). 8 640 = 9 600 × 0.9, so 8 640 is likely billed yearly and 9 600 monthly-billed. The ordering website is extra: 'Стоимость — 11 400 ₸/мес.' (Poster Site, 'Сайт для заказов из вашего заведения — за 5 минут'), listed only under paid 'Расширения'.
Add-on on top of a POS plan; not included in Starter/Mini/Business/Pro.
